lines.text: Handler. How many exits does this hall have?
Five. Two of them are vents. Count them. Every room, every time.
Honest. Good. Now count. Every room, every time.
If Cigarra improvises, let her. I leave deliberate gaps in my plans for her now. I named them. I regret naming them.
You brought both of them back. That's the job. The rest is paperwork.
